integrity: The maximum-size upper bound is structural; the equality count and symmetry census are reproduced from the embedded standard-library verifier, whose enumeration is independently checked from the comma-free definition.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns binary fixed-length-six comma-free codes and only the explicit complement/reversal group. It does not address maximal nonmaximum codes, variable lengths, larger alphabets, or additional not-proved symmetries. The full text of Niho (1973) was not accessible in this review.
title: Complete equality census for binary length-six comma-free codes
